subject: Draft MAP + procurement checklist — vendor onboarding (Zenotech)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@zenotech.com>, procurement@zenotech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Draft MAP and procurement checklist (Zenotech)

Hi Lena / Zenotech procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a condensed vendor onboarding checklist to help make the Ariba/Coupa and W-9 steps explicit for your procurement and finance teams. High-level recap:

- Goal: production access to Redwood Dedicated for Zenotech’s chatbot pilot (data-siloed)
- Target close-date (sales side): 2026-12-16 (requested by Zenotech on call)
- Critical MAP milestone this week: vendor onboarding / procurement setup (Ariba or Coupa supplier creation, W-9, banking details)

Attached: MAP-zenotech-v0.3.docx (draft) and vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx. I also dropped the live MAP in case you want to comment directly: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aZd-zenotech-MAP-v03

Proposed responsibilities (draft):
- Zenotech procurement: create supplier record in Ariba or Coupa; supply vendor ID and portal link; return completed W-9 and banking details
- Redwood (Connor / Marissa): provide vendor forms (if needed), Redwood W-9, and SOC2 evidence / technical contact for onboarding
- Legal (both sides): sign minimal SOW + PO terms; Finance to exchange payment terms (Net-30 / Net-45)

Ask for this week: can you confirm which system you prefer (Ariba vs Coupa) and the contact at Zenotech who will own supplier creation? If we have supplier contact + docs by end of Thu 12/3 we can keep the 12/16 close target.

I’m happy to jump on a quick 15-min handoff call between your vendor ops and our finance ops to accelerate.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP-zenotech-v0.3.docx (draft), vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Lena Park <lena.park@zenotech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zenotech.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Draft MAP and procurement checklist (Zenotech)

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for the documents. Quick answers:

- We primarily use Ariba internally; Coupa is used by a few subsidiaries but procurement at corporate prefers Ariba.
- Supplier creation will be handled by our vendor onboarding team (vendor.ops@zenotech.com). I looped procurement@zenotech.com above.
- I can provide a completed W-9 and banking details, but our finance requires a signed SOW/PO before we release banking details to a new vendor.

Two requests from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a Redwood W-9 and a short vendor packet (insurance cert + Redwood contact for SOC 2 artefacts)?
2) Please add a line in the MAP milestone table that legal review and PO issuance are blockers for banking details.

We are trying to align internal approvals to hit 12/16; if Redwood can provide the W-9 and vendor packet by Wed 12/2 we will prioritize supplier creation.

Lena Park
Procurement Manager, Zenotech Systems
lena.park@zenotech.com | +1 312-555-0199

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@zenotech.com>, procurement@zenotech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP — added procurement milestone & owner details

Thanks Lena — noted on Ariba and the PO requirement. I updated the MAP and checklist to make legal / PO issuance explicit blockers for banking details. Changes in brief: 

- New MAP milestone: "Vendor supplier record created in Ariba" — owner: Zenotech vendor.ops@zenotech.com — dependency: completed W-9 (Zenotech) and Redwood vendor packet
- New MAP milestone: "Redwood vendor packet delivered" — owner: Redwood (Marissa) — deliverables: Redwood W-9, insurance certificate, SOC 2 point-of-contact
- Target close-date: 2026-12-16 (conditional on PO signed by 12/10)

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Zenotech vendor.ops: create supplier in Ariba and provide supplier ID (due 2026-12-03)
- Lena Park / Zenotech procurement: confirm PO date window and payment terms (due 2026-12-06)
- Marissa Cole / Redwood: deliver W-9 + insurance cert + SOC2 contact (delivering today) — see attached vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
- Redwood legal: prepare minimal SOW for PO attachment (Connor to escalate if needed)

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (contains Ariba field mapping, required docs list, and suggested language for PO line items). I’ll also attach our W-9 after Marissa confirms the signed copy.

If useful, I can set up a 20-min triage with vendor.ops and our finance ops to speed supplier creation (I recommend Wed 12/2 10:00 AM PT).

Connor
